propositions: Destructive repair must use durable, provider-neutral pause ownership via refs/reconciler/gate instead of GitHub-only gh workflow disable/enable

Repair sequence is fail-closed: resolve git identity, read durable gate (abort if pre-existing pause), CAS-write ownership token, check reconciler lock, run repair, then cleanup by comparing pause reason to invocation token and CAS-delete by observed OID
Missing or misconfigured git user.email must abort repair before any pause write or destructive mutation
Pre-existing pause ownership must abort repair without clearing it; a replaced or changed pause must never be cleared by this invocation
Cleanup failure or CAS miss must leave the durable pause for explicit operator recovery without retrying or recreating
Both fsck --repair and doctor --repair must share the same repair-owned pause contract and work across local, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab, and bare environments
